body.statement: Theorem 1 (RankPeel reconstruction on the query-regular strict subclass).  For every \((G,P)\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{PNHZ}}\) satisfying the query-local first-jet-determining and fibre-coherence hypotheses, \(\operatorname{RankPeel}(P_X,R^{\mathrm{law}}_{P_X})\) completes and returns \(\widehat G\) with \([\widehat G]=\theta_G\).  It recovers the full binary adjacency matrix, up to independent within-layer permutations of latent labels, by deterministic pairwise pure-block tests and representative-neutrality deletion over measured pure-descendant surrogates.  The strict-subclass restriction is necessary for this law-invariant oracle construction: on the unchanged published class there is a member for which RankPeel reaches an unstable pair and returns \(\bot\).
body.justification: This is exact full-adjacency recovery on the strict first-jet-determining, fibre-coherent subclass, not on every member of the unchanged published class.
body.gap: The published-class boundary witness makes the former complete-run/full-class law-invariant headline false.
body.consumer: It identifies when the deterministic protocol's graph equals the structural target.
